title: Add a note about limiting the image density srcset takes into account
body:
Closes https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/4421 Chrome plans to experiment with limiting the density value that srcset takes into account when selecting sources. As the image source selection algorithm is UA-specific, other implementer may or may not try to follow, but I thought that adding a note to that effect can help. The change is not WPT testable as: a) It's a note. b) It refers to user-agent specific selection If needed, I'm happy to file relevant implementation bugs. - [ ] At least two implementers are interested (and none opposed): * Chromium * … - [ ] [Tests](https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt) are written and can be reviewed and commented upon at: * … - [ ] [Implementation bugs](https://github.com/whatwg/meta/blob/master/MAINTAINERS.md#handling-pull-requests) are filed: * Chrome: https://bugs.chromium.org/p/chromium/issues/detail?id=1125973 * Firefox: … * Safari: … (See [WHATWG Working Mode: Changes](https://whatwg.org/working-mode#changes) for more details.) *** ### :boom: Error: Wattsi server error :boom: ### [PR Preview](https://github.com/tobie/pr-preview#pr-preview) failed to build. _(Last tried on Jan 15, 2021, 8:00 AM UTC)_.
More PR Preview relies on a number of web services to run. There seems to be an issue with the following one: :rotating_light: [Wattsi Server](https://github.com/domenic/wattsi-server) - Wattsi Server is the web service used to build the WHATWG HTML spec. :link: [Related URL](https://build.whatwg.org/wattsi) ``` 504 Gateway Time-out
